headline: Last session: Nifty at 22,600 as Sensex falls 125 points, snapping two-week gains amid surging oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Brent crude oil prices surged to a six-month high of $117 per barrel, weighing on investor sentiment
Profit booking occurred after the market had enjoyed a two-week winning streak
Concerns over global economic stability following significant job cut announcements at Volvo and American Express
Weekly losses were driven by the impact of rising energy costs on Indian equities
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 ended the last session at 22,600, while the Sensex dropped 125 points
Indian benchmark indices recorded a 2% decline over the course of the trading week
AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% jump in Q2 net profit, reaching 858 crore
IT stocks provided a brief cushion to the market during a mid-week rebound despite overall losses
summary: In the last trading session, Indian markets snapped a two-week winning streak with the Nifty closing at 22,600. Surging Brent crude prices, which hit $117 per barrel, led to a 2% weekly decline for major indices. While AU Small Finance Bank reported strong Q2 earnings, Adani Enterprises emerged as a top weekly loser.
